channel.title: Notes by Imran Siddique
channel.description: Working notes on agent security, evidence and governance.

item.title: The LiteLLM compromise is not in any of the places you would look for it
item.description: Both poisoned versions 404 on PyPI, no CVE was ever issued, and the KEV entry filed two days later belongs to the scanner rather than the gateway.

item.title: What the encrypted reasoning paper actually counted
item.description: Coverage of the reasoning-trace harvest reported three different totals as if they disagreed. They are all the paper's own numbers, at three different denominators.

item.title: Two of the three endpoints checked authorization
item.description: The gym booking story is being told as an API with no authorization. The agent's own account says two of the three operations it touched returned 403, and one did not.
